description: Recommend a ranked shortlist of programmes for a client profile (budget, family size, mobility priority, timeline, tax goal) with reasoning. Respects closed/paused programmes.

budget_max.description: Maximum headline minimum investment the applicant will consider, in USD. Programmes with no fixed threshold are excluded from budget filtering.

family_size.description: TOTAL number of people to be included, the main applicant INCLUDED (so a couple with two children is 4).

mobility_priority.description: True when visa-free travel is the applicant's main objective.

tax_goal.description: True when the applicant's main objective is a tax outcome rather than mobility.

timeline_max_months.description: Maximum acceptable time to the outcome, in MONTHS.

type.description: Programme family: "CBI" grants citizenship, "RBI" grants residence (golden visa). Omit for both.

name: recommend_programmes

outputSchema.description: Mirabello response envelope. Tool-specific fields vary; the provenance/disclaimer envelope is always present.

book_url.description: Link to request a consultation with a Mirabello specialist, for a personal case.

data_updated.description: Date the underlying dataset was last updated.

disclaimer.description: Information, not legal/tax/financial/immigration advice; figures indicative.

error.description: Present only when the request could not be fulfilled.

source.description: Attribution for the data, when it is not Mirabello Consultancy itself.

title: Recommend Programmes
